findings.evidence: PrimeDiscriminantExamples.lean:48 `private theorem not_intCast_prime_dvd_natPrime {p l : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime] (hl : l.Prime) (hne : p ≠ l) : ¬ (p:ℤ) ∣ (l:ℤ) := by intro h; have := ... (Nat.prime_dvd_prime_iff_eq Fact.out hl).mp ...` — identical proof body.
findings.fix: Hoist the single lemma to a shared (public) location both files import and drop this copy; e.g. place it near the multiquadratic splitting infrastructure and reuse it from PrimeDiscriminantExamples too.
findings.issue: The private `not_intCast_prime_dvd_natPrime` is a character-for-character duplicate (modulo variable renaming p/l↔q/p) of the existing private lemma of the same name in TauCeti/NumberTheory/NumberField/PrimeDiscriminantExamples.lean:48.

findings.evidence: LegendreEvenPrimeDiscriminant.lean:111-116 proves `legendreSym q (evenPrimeDiscriminantRadicand 8) = 1 ↔ q%8=1∨q%8=7` via `legendreSym.eq_one_iff (a := (2:ℤ))` and `ZMod.exists_sq_eq_two_iff hq`; EvenPrimeDiscriminant.lean:75 `evenPrimeDiscriminantRadicand_eight : evenPrimeDiscriminantRadicand 8 = 2`.
findings.fix: Reuse the existing result, e.g. `rw [← evenPrimeDiscriminantRadicand_eight]; exact legendreSym_evenPrimeDiscriminantRadicand_eight_eq_one_iff htwo` (importing LegendreEvenPrimeDiscriminant), or hoist a single shared `legendreSym_two_eq_one_iff` used by both.
findings.issue: `legendreSym_two_eq_one_iff : legendreSym q (2:ℤ) = 1 ↔ q%8=1∨q%8=7` re-derives (same `legendreSym.eq_one_iff` + `ZMod.exists_sq_eq_two_iff` steps) the already-proved fact about radicand `2` in TauCeti/NumberTheory/Multiquadratic/LegendreEvenPrimeDiscriminant.lean:111, where `evenPrimeDiscriminantRadicand 8 = 2` (simp, EvenPrimeDiscriminant.lean:75).

summary: The core prime-radicand splitting specialization and the concrete ℚ(√2,√3) corollaries are genuinely new, but two supporting pieces re-derive existing TauCeti lemmas verbatim.
